audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions entries are absent: Bailout (W) needs anti-heal timing, and Loyalty Program (E) shields absorb your burst window.

audit.corrected: Folded both into breakdown.cooldowns alongside the real R/W/E cooldown numbers.
